description: Runnable approximate geometry specification; not as-built and not recovered Bentley demo inputs.
floor_count_evidence: 40-storey convention from S4; this specific slab schedule is our approximation
module_evidence: teaching approximation in S7-S8, explicitly not an as-built measurement
floor_schedule_note: 40 slabs: ground plus 8.4 to 168 inclusive. Omit 4.2 for a simplified double-height lobby. Datum is slab underside.
profile_evidence: All radius knots and their elevations below are assistant-selected visual approximations, NOT sourced dimensions or Bentley demo parameters.
profile_interpolation: shape-preserving cubic Hermite interpolation of squared radius; take nonnegative square root
rotation_evidence: public reconstruction convention, S7 and S9; not verified as a demo input
unnotched_floor_rule: Full slab when the integer regular-height-module index z/4.2 is divisible by 6; visualization convention only, not a fire-compartment design.
diagrid_topology_evidence: Original computational implementation of the repeating-frame reconstruction relationship discussed in S7-S8.
glazing_grid_evidence: Our computational sampling choice. NOT an interpretation of a Revit 72x72 half-surface grid as whole-building panel counts.
visual_defaults_evidence: Insets, member/slab dimensions, notch size, crown samples and opacities are implementation choices, not measured values.
count_note: Expected counts apply to this mathematical recipe, NOT the real building or Bentley demo. Native element counts depend on batching.
